issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2024 net income was about $59.2 billion, not $74.1 billion. A net income above the $68.6 billion operating income is also implausible for Amazon in that year.

data.summary: Revenue ($638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B), operating income ($68.6B), total assets ($624.9B) and cash and cash equivalents ($78.8B) match Amazon's reported FY2024 results. The net income figure is wrong: it was about $59.2B, not $74.1B.
